_comment: Every posted rate on the site. Edit this file to change what Northern Birch advertises -- see docs/updating-rates.md. Values appear verbatim; the build refuses to run if one is missing, malformed, or contradicts another.
_provenance: Where each figure came from and when it was last checked against the source. UNVERIFIED means nobody has confirmed it against northernbirchcu.com -- it must not be published.

verified._everything_else: UNVERIFIED -- carried over from the original demo and not yet checked against the source above

_rates: Named rates the site quotes outside the table: product cards, member notifications, calculators.
_tables: The posted rate table, exactly as it appears on /rates. Rows are [term, rate].
